description_en: Sends a unicast command by calling SendUnicastCommand
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan send-unicast-command --iot-instance-id iotx-oxssharez --dev-eui 0000000000000000 --max-retries 0 --clean-up false --fport 0 --confirmed false --content xxx --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendUnicastCommand

parameters.description_en: The ID of the IoT Platform instance. An empty value indicates the public instance.
parameters.description_zh: 物联网平台的实例id，为空表示公共实例。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the IoT Platform instance. An empty value indicates the public instance
parameters.help_zh: 物联网平台的实例id，为空表示公共实例
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of retries. Default value: 0.
parameters.help_en: The maximum number of retries. Default value: 0
parameters.name: max_retries

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to clear the queued instructions for the node and send this instruction. Default value: **false**.
parameters.description_zh: 是否清空该节点的堆积指令，并下发该指令。默认为**false**。
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to clear the queued instructions for the node and send this instruction. Default value: **false**
parameters.help_zh: 是否清空该节点的堆积指令，并下发该指令。默认为**false**
parameters.name: clean_up

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether the instruction is a confirmed instruction. Default value: **false**.
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the instruction is a confirmed instruction. Default value: **false**
parameters.name: confirmed

parameters.description_en: The content to send. The value is a hexadecimal string with a maximum length of 51 bytes (102 hexadecimal characters).
parameters.description_zh: 要发送的内容。16进制字符串，最长51个字节（如果换算成16进制字符串，最长为51*2个字符）。
parameters.help_en: The content to send. The value is a hexadecimal string with a maximum length of 51 bytes (102 hexadecimal characters)
parameters.help_zh: 要发送的内容。16进制字符串，最长51个字节（如果换算成16进制字符串，最长为51*2个字符）
parameters.name: content
